title: 2005 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: Suppose \(d\) is a digit. For how many values of \(d\) is \[2.00d5 > 2.005?\]

solutions.text:
The numbers \(2.00d5\) and \(2.005\) first differ in the thousandths place: \(d\) is compared with \(5\).

Thus \(2.00d5>2.005\) exactly when \(d\ge 5\). The possible digits are \(5,\) \(6,\) \(7,\) \(8,\) \(9\), for \(5\) values.

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Compare the thousandths digit of \(2.00d5\) with that of \(2.005\).
The digit \(d\) must be at least \(5\).
